injury_reports.name: Zachariah Branch
injury_reports.summary: Branch caught both of his targets for 10 yards while also adding 65 kickoff-return yards and 25 yards as a punt returner during Monday night's 45-24 win over the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Jahan Dotson
injury_reports.summary: Dotson caught two of three passes for 54 yards and a touchdown during the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Austin Hooper
injury_reports.summary: Hooper caught his only target for nine yards during Monday's 45-24 win at New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Drake London
injury_reports.summary: London brought in five of six targets for 96 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Jake Matthews
injury_reports.summary: Matthews (groin) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.

injury_reports.name: Michael Penix Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Penix completed 15 of 20 passes for 223 yards with one touchdown and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-2 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
injury_reports.summary: Pitts secured all three targets for 47 yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Bijan Robinson
injury_reports.summary: Robinson rushed 19 times for 145 yards and two touchdowns and brought in one of two targets for two yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Robinson rushed 14 times for 62 yards and three touchdowns and brought in his sole target for five yards in the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday night.

injury_reports.name: Cooper Rush
injury_reports.summary: Rush (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Saints but will serve as the emergency quarterback, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Olamide Zaccheaus
injury_reports.summary: Zaccheaus failed to haul in his lone target during the Falcons' 45-24 win over the Saints on Monday.

injury_reports.name: Divine Deablo
injury_reports.summary: Deablo (hamstring) is listed as questionable ahead of Sunday's game against the Ravens, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site  reports.

injury_reports.name: Samson Ebukam
injury_reports.summary: questionable

injury_reports.name: C.J. Henderson
injury_reports.summary: Henderson recorded 10 tackles (nine solo), a pass defensed, a forced fumble and a fumble recovery during Monday's 45-24 win at New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Harold Perkins Jr.
injury_reports.summary: Perkins recorded 10 tackles (seven solo) including 0.5 sacks and a pass defensed during Monday's 45-24 win at New Orleans.

injury_reports.name: Za'Darius Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith (concussion/neck) has been downgraded to out for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Nick Folk
injury_reports.summary: Folk made his lone field-goal attempt all six PATs in Monday night's 45-24 win over the Saints.

injury_reports.name: Yasir Abdullah
injury_reports.summary: The Falcons placed Abdullah (hamstring) on injured reserve Saturday, Tori McElhaney of the team's official site reports.

injury_reports.name: Mark Andrews
injury_reports.summary: Andrews caught five of six targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-18 win over Tennessee.

injury_reports.name: Rashod Bateman
injury_reports.summary: Bateman (shoulder) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

injury_reports.name: Zay Flowers
injury_reports.summary: Flowers (foot) is slated to play in Sunday night's game in Atlanta, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

injury_reports.name: Derrick Henry
injury_reports.summary: Henry carried the ball 23 times for 73 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-18 win over the Titans. He also caught both his targets for six yards.

injury_reports.name: Matthew Hibner
injury_reports.summary: Hibner caught both of his targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 24-18 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Justice Hill
injury_reports.summary: Hill rushed one time for three yards in Sunday's 24-18 win over the Titans. He added two catches for 22 yards on three targets.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Huntley
injury_reports.summary: Huntley will start Sunday night's game against the Falcons after Lamar Jackson (ankle) was ruled out Friday, Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic reports.

injury_reports.name: Lamar Jackson
injury_reports.summary: Jackson (ankle), who has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Falcons, has a "real chance" to return to action next week against Cleveland, pending how he responds to rehab, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

injury_reports.name: Cam Jurgens
injury_reports.summary: Jurgens (concussion) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Chris Moore
injury_reports.summary: Moore (ankle) was a full participant at the Ravens' practice Thursday.

injury_reports.name: Elijah Sarratt
injury_reports.summary: Sarratt reeled in one of two targets for 13 yards in a 24-18 win against Tennessee on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Nick Vannett
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens signed Vannett to the active roster off their practice squad Wednesday.

injury_reports.name: Devontez Walker
injury_reports.summary: Walker caught one of his two targets for 19 yards during Baltimore's win over the Titans on Sunday.

injury_reports.name: Trey Hendrickson
injury_reports.summary: Hendrickson (finger) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's game against the Falcons, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Marlon Humphrey
injury_reports.summary: Humphrey (calf/hamstring) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons, Adam Caplan of SiriusXM NFL Radio reports.

injury_reports.name: Trenton Simpson
injury_reports.summary: Simpson recorded nine total tackles (two solo) and an interception during Sunday's 24-18 win over Tennessee.

injury_reports.name: Roquan Smith
injury_reports.summary: Smith recorded six total tackles (one solo) during Sunday's 24-18 win over the Titans.

injury_reports.name: Tyler Loop
injury_reports.summary: Loop went 1-for-2 on field-goal tries and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 24-18 win over Tennessee.

injury_reports.name: Ja'Kobi Lane
injury_reports.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Friday that Lane (wrist) is "doing really well" and "has put himself in a great position to be ready to roll when the time permits."

injury_reports.name: Durham Smythe
injury_reports.summary: The Ravens placed Smythe (Achilles) on their injured reserve list Wednesday, Ryan Mink of the Ravens' official site reports.
